79	// A registration whose INSERT is rejected by storage returns 503
80	// storage_unavailable and is atomic: no row, no order consumed, existing
81	// records untouched in every field, ordering and conflict flag. Read-only paths
82	// (queries, same-content retry, different-content 409) keep working while the
83	// failure condition holds. Once writes are allowed again the original request
84	// succeeds with the next order, the state survives a close/reopen, and the
85	// following registration continues the sequence.
86	func TestRegisterStorageWriteFailureIsAtomicAndRecoverable(t *testing.T) {
87		router, st, dbPath, admin := newFaultRouter(t)
88	
89		// Two ingress policies in one namespace/label: [80,100] deny then
90		// [100,200] allow; the closed intervals touch at 100, so the second is
91		// flagged while the first keeps conflict=false.
92		denyBody := singleRuleBody("payments", "deny-web", "tier=backend",
93			"ingress", "deny", 80, 100, `{"mode": "enforce"}`)
94		deny := registerCreated(t, router, denyBody, 1, false)
95		allowBody := singleRuleBody("payments", "allow-web", "tier=backend",
96			"ingress", "allow", 100, 200, `{"mode": "enforce"}`)
97		allow := registerCreated(t, router, allowBody, 2, true)
98	
99		// Storage stays readable but refuses new records.
100		blockStorageInserts(t, admin)
101	
102		// A brand-new identity (egress, so it would not clash by rules) with legal
103		// string plugin params: the write is genuinely rejected -> 503.
104		blockedBody := singleRuleBody("payments", "allow-dns", "tier=backend",
105			"egress", "allow", 53, 53, `{"mode": "enforce"}`)
106		postExpect(t, router, blockedBody, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "storage_unavailable")
107	
108		// Repeating the failed request still fails the same way: it never created a
109		// row, so there is nothing to idempotently return.
110		postExpect(t, router, blockedBody, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "storage_unavailable")
111	
112		// Every read path still returns exactly the two original records, identical
113		// in all submitted fields, order and conflict flags, sorted by order.
114		wantOnlyOriginals := []map[string]any{deny, allow}
115		for _, target := range []string{
116			"/v1/net-policies?namespace=payments",
117			"/v1/net-policies?label=tier%3Dbackend",
118			"/v1/net-policies?namespace=payments&label=tier%3Dbackend",
119		} {
120			if items := listItems(t, router, target); !reflect.DeepEqual(items, wantOnlyOriginals) {
121				t.Fatalf("GET %s items = %v, want unchanged originals %v", target, items, wantOnlyOriginals)
122			}
123		}
124	
125		// Same identity with identical content on a committed record is a read-only
126		// retry: 200 with the original record despite the write outage.
127		retryExisting := doRequest(router, http.MethodPost, "/v1/net-policies", denyBody)
128		if retryExisting.Code != http.StatusOK {
129			t.Fatalf("existing identity retry status = %d, want %d: %s",
130				retryExisting.Code, http.StatusOK, retryExisting.Body.String())
131		}
132		if got := decodeRecord(t, retryExisting.Body.Bytes()); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, deny) {
133			t.Fatalf("retry record = %v, want original %v", got, deny)
134		}
135	
136		// Same identity with different content stays a 409: the lookup and content
137		// comparison happen before any write attempt.
138		changedBody := singleRuleBody("payments", "deny-web", "tier=backend",
139			"ingress", "deny", 80, 100, `{"mode": "audit"}`)
140		postExpect(t, router, changedBody, http.StatusConflict, "NetPolicyConflictError")
141	
142		// Lift the failure condition and resubmit the request that had failed:
143		// it now commits with order 3 and conflict=false (egress never clashes with
144		// the ingress records).
145		restoreStorageInserts(t, admin)
146		recovered := registerCreated(t, router, blockedBody, 3, false)
147	
148		// Submitting it again is now an idempotent retry returning the same record.
149		again := doRequest(router, http.MethodPost, "/v1/net-policies", blockedBody)
150		if again.Code != http.StatusOK {
151			t.Fatalf("recovered retry status = %d, want %d: %s",
152				again.Code, http.StatusOK, again.Body.String())
153		}
154		if got := decodeRecord(t, again.Body.Bytes()); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, recovered) {
155			t.Fatalf("recovered retry record = %v, want %v", got, recovered)
156		}
157	
158		// Close and reopen the same database file: all three records survive with
159		// every field, order and conflict flag intact.
160		if err := st.Close(); err != nil {
161			t.Fatalf("close store: %v", err)
162		}
163		reopened, err := store.Open(dbPath)
164		if err != nil {
165			t.Fatalf("reopen store: %v", err)
166		}
167		t.Cleanup(func() { reopened.Close() })
168		router = NewRouter(reopened)
169	
170		wantPersisted := []map[string]any{deny, allow, recovered}
171		if items := listItems(t, router, "/v1/net-policies?namespace=payments&label=tier%3Dbackend"); !reflect.DeepEqual(items, wantPersisted) {
172			t.Fatalf("items after reopen = %v, want %v", items, wantPersisted)
173		}
174	
175		// The failed registration consumed no order: the next legal new identity
176		// takes order 4 (egress allow matches the existing egress in action, so no
177		// conflict).
178		nextBody := singleRuleBody("payments", "after-recovery", "tier=backend",
179			"egress", "allow", 53, 53, `{}`)
180		registerCreated(t, router, nextBody, 4, false)
181	}

// gatedBody delivers prefix, signals delivered, then waits for release before
// producing the suffix (or err). It models a request whose body has not
// finished arriving.
type gatedBody struct {
	prefix    []byte
	suffix    []byte
	err       error
	delivered chan struct{}
	release   chan struct{}
	once      sync.Once

func (g *gatedBody) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if len(g.prefix) > 0 {
		n := copy(p, g.prefix)
		g.prefix = g.prefix[n:]
		if len(g.prefix) == 0 {

	if len(g.suffix) > 0 {

		g.suffix = g.suffix[n:]
		return n, nil
	}
	return 0, io.EOF
}

func chunksOf(body string, size int) []string {
	var chunks []string
	for i := 0; i < len(body); i += size {

		chunks = append(chunks, body[i:end])
	}
	return chunks
}

新增 `internal/api/chunked_body_regression_test.go`（仅此一个文件，未改动任何生产代码、接口或数据库结构），围绕 `POST /v1/net-policies` 的请求体分段到达与中途结束，共 7 个测试：

**基础设施**（测试内私有 reader，不触碰公开行为）：
- `chunkedReader` — 按指定字节边界分段投递请求体
- `failingReader` — 投递数据后返回非 EOF 读错误
- `gatedBody` — 投递完整对象后阻塞，由测试释放 EOF / 非法尾部 / 读错误，模拟"对象已到齐但请求体未结束"

**测试覆盖**：
1. `TestChunkedBodyRegistersIdenticallyToFullBody` — 同一合法请求完整输入作对照（order 2、conflict=true），8 种分段（UTF-8 多字节字符内部、JSON `\u5317` 转义内部及两侧、端口数字内部、pluginParams 成员名/值内部、逐字节）逐一验证 201 且记录与对照完全一致；分段重试返回 200 原记录；GET 命名空间/标签/交集查询完整字段升序；不同内容重试仍 409；后续新身份取得下一顺序；`/healthz` 不变。
2. `TestChunkedBodyTruncatedBeforeClose` — 字段名、字符串值、规则数组、顶层对象未闭合即结束，均 400 + `InvalidNetPolicyInputError`，无记录、不消耗顺序。
3. `TestChunkedBodyReadError` — 非 EOF 读错误（对象中途、完整对象到达后读取失败两种）均同一 400。
4. `TestChunkedBodyTrailingData` — 完整对象后 JSON 空白被接受（201）；第二个 JSON 值、非空白垃圾均 400。
5. `TestChunkedBodyPluginParamsValidation` — 分段不改变校验：非法成员值不被后来同名合法字符串掩盖；合法重复成员取最后字符串值；`\u006dode` 按 JSON 解码后识别为 `mode`。
6. `TestFailedChunkedRequestsLeaveExistingRecordUntouched` — 对已有身份（conflict=true）施加五类失败请求（含最终合法值等于已存内容的隐藏非法成员），均 400 而非 200/409，原记录各字段、顺序、冲突标记不变，下一条合法策略取得下一顺序。
7. `TestInflightRequestInvisibleUntilBodyCompletes` — 门控 reader 阻塞期间查询只见已提交记录；干净结束后候选记录以 201 可见；非法尾部或读失败后候选保持不可见且不消耗顺序。
